name: HITL Expire
description: Expire one open HITL request whose timeout has fallen due: its record becomes expired and the requester's Job fails. Only the venue invokes it, from the event a request with a timeout scheduled; anyone else is refused. A request already answered, rejected, expired or cancelled, or gone, is left as it is.
creator: Covia

user.description: DID of the user whose h/ inbox holds the request.

status.description: The request's status now; absent when there is no such request.
